title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
summary: A visitor to a remote Yorkshire farmhouse hears the history of the Earnshaw family, and the foundling Heathcliff, whose bond with Catherine and need for revenge damage two households across generations.
readIf: you want a stormy, intense classic where love and cruelty are tangled together.
skipIf: you want sympathetic characters or a satisfying romance, because few are kind.

pairings.reason: The more hopeful Brontë novel with a heroine who keeps her own moral sense.
A later gothic about a house, obsession and a dead woman's hold on the living.
Another story of a man shaped by thwarted love who builds a life around his obsession.
